root.name: アメリカン・エレクトリック・パワー

rows.ja: 送電事業の共同出資先

relations.text: 2024年10〜12月に、固体酸化物形燃料電池100MW分の購入契約をAEPの開発子会社が締結
relations.text_en: AEP’s development subsidiary signed a purchase agreement in Q4 2024 for 100 MW of solid oxide fuel cells

source.label: AEP 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Devco executed a purchase agreement with Bloom Energy, acquiring 100 MWs of solid oxide fuel cells.

companies.name: ドミニオン・エナジー

relations.text: 送電会社バレーリンクを、ドミニオンの関連会社などと2024年に設立(AEPの持分31.14%)
relations.text_en: Valley Link transmission company was formed in 2024 with Dominion affiliates and others (AEP owns 31.14%)

source.label: AEP 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Valley Link Transmission Company, LLC, a holding company formed by Transource Energy, affiliates of Dominion Energy and FirstEnergy in 2024, which is 31.14% owned by AEP.

relations.text: 送電会社バレーリンクをファーストエナジーの関連会社などと2024年に設立(AEPの持分31.14%)
relations.text_en: Valley Link transmission company was formed in 2024 with FirstEnergy affiliates and others (AEP owns 31.14%)

source.label: AEP 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Valley Link Transmission Company, LLC, a holding company formed by Transource Energy, affiliates of Dominion Energy and FirstEnergy in 2024, which is 31.14% owned by AEP.

relations.text: 西バージニア州の送電会社PATH-WVは、ファーストエナジーとAEPが50%ずつ出資
relations.text_en: PATH-WV, a West Virginia transmission company, is owned 50% by FirstEnergy and 50% by AEP

source.label: AEP 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: PATH West Virginia Transmission Company, LLC, a joint venture-owned 50% by FirstEnergy and 50% by AEP.

companies.name: センチュリ・ホールディングス

relations.text: 電力・ガス設備工事の顧客としてAEPを記載
relations.text_en: Names American Electric Power among its utility-infrastructure customers

source.label: Centuri Holdings 10-K
source.quote: Our customers include American Electric Power, Enbridge, Entergy, Exelon, NiSource, National Grid, Sempra Energy and Southern Company, among others.
